AC veya DC kaynak makinesi kullanılabili: An AC or DC welding machine can be used. DC reverse polarity (DCEP) gives deeper penetration.
AFFF (aqueous film-forming foam) yakıt ü: AFFF (aqueous film-forming foam) extinguishes quickly by forming a water film on the fuel; protein/fluoroprotein foam gives a durable blanket; alcohol-resistant (AR) foam forms a polymeric layer for polar solvents (alcohol, acetone). AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator), alter: The AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) keeps the alternator terminal voltage constant despite load changes (class/IEC tolerance: ±2.5% in steady state, ±3.5% for emergency generators). Operating principle: it samples the output voltage, compares it with a reference and adjusts the excitation current through a brushless exciter or static excitation. The ETO calibrates the AVR droop/quadrature droop setting so as to balance reactive load sharing between generators running in parallel.
Acil durum becerileri ancak düzenli, ger: Emergency skills stay alive only through regular, realistic drills. Under SOLAS III/19, fire and abandon ship drills are held at least once a month (III/19.3.2), and enclosed space entry and rescue drills at least every two months. A drill done "on paper", where everyone just waits their turn, is useless; a drill that simulates real conditions (smoke machine, darkness, real equipment) teaches.
Acil kompresör (emergency air compressor: Emergency air compressor: a small compressor, diesel-driven or supplied from the emergency switchboard during a power failure; for the first start of the auxiliary generator engines from dead ship condition.
Acil yangın pompasının güç kaynağı, ana: The source of power of the emergency fire pump must be outside the space where the main fire pumps and their sources of power are located.
Air dryer: refrigerant (çiğ noktası yakl: Air dryer: refrigerant type (dew point approx. +3 °C) or desiccant type (dew point -20 to -40 °C).
Akan sıvı, su jeti, buhar/mist ve hareke: Flowing liquids, water jets, steam/mist and moving particles accumulate a static electric charge; when this charge discharges (spark), it can ignite a flammable atmosphere. Washing with water (Butterworthing) in particular carries a higher static risk than crude oil, because water droplets/mist carry a high charge. This is why water washing in a tank that is not inerted is carried out only under the controlled conditions defined in ISGOTT.
Akdeniz, Baltık, Karadeniz gibi özel ala: In special areas such as the Mediterranean, the Baltic and the Black Sea, discharge to sea of most garbage other than food waste is prohibited; in these areas, food waste may be discharged only while en route, comminuted or ground, and at least 12 nautical miles from the nearest land. Waste that cannot be discharged to sea must be delivered to port reception facilities.
Alarm çaldığında mühendis önce alarmı ta: When an alarm sounds, the engineer first acknowledges it, investigates the cause and then intervenes if necessary — the alarm is never reset blindly. Critical alarms (LO low pressure, jacket water high temp, oil mist high) can trigger a main engine slowdown/shutdown; in that case, the bridge is informed immediately.
Ana makine performansı doğrudan yakıt ka: Main engine performance depends directly on fuel quality. The Second Engineer keeps the injection viscosity constant (typically 10-15 cSt) with the viscotherm/heater; low viscosity causes pump wear, while high viscosity causes poor atomization, poor injection and carbon formation.
Ana makine ve essential auxiliary için m: A minimum spare parts list is defined for the main engine and essential auxiliaries (e.g. spare piston ring set, exhaust valve, fuel injector, bearing shells). On single-engine ships this list is longer.
Anchor windlass (ırgat), demiri kaldırıp: The anchor windlass heaves up and lowers the anchor; the chain stopper (devil's claw/guillotine) takes the cable load off the windlass while the ship is riding at anchor. The Bosun coordinates the use of this equipment in the correct sequence and in a safe manner. The windlass brake, brake holding and clutch operations are critical control points.
Ani dökülmelerde emici ped, granül veya: For sudden spills, absorbent pads, granules or rags are used; once the oil has been absorbed, these materials are collected as special waste and disposed of properly (oily rags can ignite spontaneously — they are kept in a metal container with a lid). The Wiper also checks that the SOPEP/SMPEP absorbent material stock is ready.
Annex V çöpü kategorilere ayırır: A (pla: Annex V divides garbage into categories: A (plastics), B (food waste), C (domestic waste — paper, rags, glass, metal, bottles), D (cooking oil), E (incinerator ash), F (operational waste), G (animal carcasses), H (fishing gear), I (e-waste), J (cargo residues — non-HME), K (cargo residues — HME). Each category has its own discharge/storage rules. The Chief Officer ensures that the crew categorizes garbage correctly.
Arıtılmış atık su, onaylı STP ile kriter: Treated sewage may be discharged in compliance with the criteria through an approved STP; no distance or speed condition applies to it. Comminuted/disinfected sewage is discharged more than 3 nautical miles from the nearest land, and sewage that is not comminuted more than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land; discharge from a holding tank is made at a moderate rate while the ship is en route at not less than 4 knots. Discharge is restricted in port and in the special area (Baltic Sea; passenger ships); the sewage is retained in a tank or delivered to a shore facility.
Atmosfer testi belirli sırayla yapılır:: The atmosphere test is carried out in a set order: first oxygen (must read a steady 21% by volume), then flammable gas (LEL <1%, hydrocarbons), then toxic gases (H₂S, CO). Measurements are taken with a calibrated and certified multi-gas detector. The test is carried out before entering the space, at different levels (top, middle, bottom — gases stratify according to density) and from outside (remote probe).
Attended dönemde fiziksel turlar ve süre: In attended periods, physical rounds and continuous monitoring are essential. In UMS periods, the dead man alarm (personnel alarm) system is activated; personnel entering the engine room confirm that they are safe by pressing a button at set intervals. The cadet must be familiar with this system and learn the entry and exit procedure.
Aşırı ısınan yatak yağ buharı (oil mist): An overheated bearing produces oil vapor (oil mist); the oil mist detector and crankcase relief valves protect against explosion. Opening the crankcase after a hot bearing before it has cooled sufficiently carries a risk of explosion.
Ballast operasyonu, yük operasyonuyla se: The ballast operation is planned in step with the cargo operation: ballast is pumped out (deballasting) as cargo comes on board and taken in as cargo is discharged, so that draft, trim, GM and strength stay within limits at all times. The Chief Officer matches the ballast pumping rate to the loading rate and verifies the draft at each stage.
Baltık Denizi, Kuzey Denizi, Kuzey Ameri: The Baltic Sea, the North Sea, the North American coasts (200 nm), the United States Caribbean Sea area and (since 1 May 2025) the Mediterranean Sea are designated as SOx ECAs.
Bağlantı, transfere başlamadan önce test: Before transfer starts, the connection is tested and all flanges are watched for leaks. If there is a leak, the pressure is released and the gasket/bolts are corrected.
Baş Mühendis için ilk adımlar: emergency: The Chief Engineer's first steps: confirm that the emergency generator is on line, determine the cause of the main generator stop (fuel, contamination, cooling, governor, breaker trip), check the preferential trip status and re-energize the main busbar.
Bir gemi yalnızca radarla başka bir gemi: If a ship detects the presence of another ship by radar alone, she determines whether a risk of collision is developing. If there is a risk, Rule 19(d) requires certain maneuvers to be avoided: an alteration of course to port for a ship forward of the beam (other than a ship being overtaken), and an alteration of course towards a ship abeam or abaft the beam. Action is taken early and is substantial.

CII rating (A-E) yıllık hesaplanır; SEEM: The CII rating (A-E) is calculated annually; the SEEMP Part III improvement plan is followed. A D rating for three consecutive years, or an E rating, requires a corrective plan.
COLREG Kural 20-31, gemilerin gece göste: COLREG Rules 20-31 define the navigation lights ships show at night and the shapes they show by day. The officer of the watch must be able to read from the other ship's lights her type, size, aspect (view from ahead/astern/abeam) and intention: the combination of green-red sidelights and masthead lights shows which way the ship is heading, two red lights in a vertical line indicate NUC, and red-white-red indicates RAM.
COLREG Rule 7 (çatışma riski) ve Rule 8: Although decisions under COLREG Rule 7 (risk of collision) and Rule 8 (action to avoid collision) belong to the OOW, the accurate and timely lookout information provided by the AB is the basis for these decisions. If observations such as a steady bearing, a light coming closer or a new target appearing are reported at once, the OOW can remove the risk with an early maneuver that is large enough to be readily apparent.
Can salları yılda bir kez (bazı tiplerde: Liferafts are opened and inspected once a year (for some types, every 30 months with an extended-interval approval) at a servicing station approved by the Administration. The Safety Officer tracks the service due date of each raft on board; a raft past its due date cannot be used and is a deficiency in itself. The raft must be securely placed in its cradle, and the painter must be made fast to a fixed point.
Can salları yıllık olarak (bazı tiplerde: Liferafts are opened, inspected and repacked annually (at an extended interval for some types) at an approved service station. The HRU (hydrostatic release) provides automatic release at a depth of not more than 4 m; the HRU expiry date (generally 2 years) is tracked, and the lashing/weak link must be correctly attached.

Light and battery expiry dates and the presence of retro-reflective tape and whistles are checked.
Cargo manifest, custom ve liman otoritel: The cargo manifest is the official document required by customs and port authorities. The Chief Officer checks that the manifest agrees with the actual cargo. The NOR (Notice of Readiness) is tendered to the charterer when the ship is ready for cargo; laytime commences after the notice time stated in the C/P has expired (e.g. 6 hours after NOR).
Carriage ban (Reg. 14.1) gereği, scrubbe: Under the carriage ban (Reg. 14.1), ships without a scrubber may not even carry fuel above 0.50% on board. PSC takes samples from the main engine and the service tank (in-use and onboard samples) and compares them with the MARPOL bottle.
Container, ro-ro, project cargo ve deck: Container, ro-ro, project cargo and deck cargo lashing is reassessed with CSM/CSS Code calculations against the expected heavy weather accelerations. If necessary, additional lashings are fitted and the tightness of the existing lashings is checked; slack turnbuckles are tightened. Going on deck to check lashings once heavy seas have set in is extremely dangerous, so preparations are completed in advance.
D-2 (Performans standardı): Balast su ar: D-2 (Performance standard): Specified organism limits must be met by means of a ballast water treatment system. Since 8 September 2024, all ships covered by the Convention must comply with D-2.
DOC 5 yıl geçerlidir ve yıllık doğrulama: The DOC is valid for 5 years and is subject to annual verification (±3-month window). The SMC is also valid for 5 years, but its intermediate verification takes place between the 2nd and 3rd anniversary dates of the SMC. The Master keeps track of these windows; a delayed certificate verification is a ground for detention in a PSC (Port State Control) inspection. Interim certificates (Interim DOC/SMC) are issued in cases such as delivery of a new ship or a change of company; an Interim DOC is valid for up to 12 months, and an Interim SMC for 6 months (extendable by a further 6 months in special cases).
Dedicated seawater ballast tank'larda (v: PSPC (Performance Standard for Protective Coatings, SOLAS II-1/3-2) applies to dedicated seawater ballast tanks (and to double-side skin spaces of bulk carriers of 150 m and above); coating condition is rated GOOD/FAIR/POOR and records are requested at survey.
Deflection gauge (dial indicator), her s: The deflection gauge (dial indicator) is fitted between the crank webs of each cylinder. The crankshaft is turned through 360° with the turning gear and readings are taken at 5 positions (either side of BDC, port, TDC and starboard); no reading is taken exactly at BDC because the connecting rod is in the way.
Demir tarama (dragging) veya acil demirl: When the anchor is dragging, or during emergency anchoring, the Bosun is the most critical person on the station; keeping the team safe, the Bosun coordinates a quick and correct response. Any sudden jerk, unexpected load or sign of slipping in the cable is reported to the bridge immediately.
Denizcilik emniyet bilgisi (MSI) — seyir: Maritime safety information (MSI) — navigational warnings, weather reports, SAR information — is received automatically. NAVTEX (518 kHz) provides MSI in coastal waters, and Inmarsat SafetyNET on the open sea (A3). These broadcasts are recorded continuously and automatically.
Denizcilik sektöründe MARPOL Annex VI Re: In the maritime sector, under MARPOL Annex VI Reg. 12, new installations containing R-12 have been prohibited since 19 May 2005, and new installations containing R-22 since 1 January 2020.
Dikey tip (vertical shaft) windlass, zin: In the vertical shaft windlass, the cable lifter (wildcat/gypsy) is on deck and the drive mechanism is in a compartment below deck. It saves space on the forecastle.
Distilat yakıtlar başlıca DMX, DMA, DMZ,: Distillate fuels are mainly classified as DMX, DMA, DMZ and DMB, and residual fuels as RMA, RMB, RMD, RME, RMG and RMK.
Distile yakıtlar: DMX, DMA (MGO), DMZ, D: Distillate fuels: DMX, DMA (MGO), DMZ, DMB – low-viscosity, clean fuels.
Dökme yük kalıntısı, MARPOL Annex V Appe: If a bulk cargo residue is HME (harmful to the marine environment) according to the criteria in MARPOL Annex V Appendix I, it must not be discharged into the sea; it is retained on board, together with the wash water, and delivered to a reception facility. The shipper declares whether the cargo is HME; the Chief Officer checks this declaration and decides on the discharge of hold washing water accordingly. If there is any doubt about the HME classification, the cargo is treated as harmful.
Dümen, dönme ekseni ile yüzey alanının d: Rudders are classified according to the position of the axis of rotation relative to the distribution of the surface area: balanced (spade/balanced), semi-balanced and unbalanced. In a balanced rudder, the axis divides the surface, so the turning moment (torque) is reduced. The flap/Becker rudder provides additional lift at large rudder angles by means of a trailing flap (high maneuverability).
Dümenci, pusula başını (compass heading): The helmsman uses the compass heading as the reference but does not keep moving the helm; when the ship's head swings, the helmsman meets the swing with small, well-timed helm movements ("meeting the swing" technique). Over-steering makes the ship snake along an uneven track and wastes fuel; under-steering lets the ship wander off course. A good helmsman keeps a steady course with minimum helm.
EEXI (Energy Efficiency Existing Ship In: EEXI (Energy Efficiency Existing Ship Index) is a one-time technical index; it measures the ship's design efficiency, and compliance is achieved through measures such as EPL (Engine Power Limitation). CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator), on the other hand, is operational and annual; it measures the ship's emissions per unit of carrying capacity and distance sailed (gCO2/dwt·nm) and gives a rating from A to E.
ETO, şebeke güç kalitesini sürekli izler: The ETO continuously monitors the power quality of the network: voltage tolerance +6%/-10% continuous / ±20% transient, frequency tolerance ±5% continuous / ±10% transient (IACS UR E5). A low power factor (cosφ < 0.8) indicates excessive reactive load; it increases the alternator current unnecessarily and causes heating. The ETO corrects the power factor with capacitor banks or reactive load management.
Eklerin çoğu belirli kayıt defterleri zo: Most annexes require specific record books: the Oil Record Book (ORB Part I/II) and the Garbage Record Book (Part I/II). These books are among the documents most frequently examined in PSC inspections, and errors lead to a "deficiency" or even detention of the ship.
El dümenine geçiş/çıkış zamanları, steer: The times of changing to and from hand steering, steering gear tests and changes of helmsman are recorded in the bridge logbook; the AB also contributes to the accuracy of these records. Under SOLAS V/26, the steering gear is tested within 12 hours before departure; the AB contributes to this test by moving the helm in response to orders.
Elektroliz (elektro-klorinasyon): Deniz: Electrolysis (electro-chlorination): Produces active chlorine (hypochlorite) from seawater.
Emisyon Kontrol Alanlarına (ECA) girişte: On entering Emission Control Areas (ECA), the ship changes over to low-sulfur fuel (MGO or ULSFO; max. 0.10% sulfur). Since MGO is cleaner and has a lower viscosity, the load on the filters decreases; however, its lubricating properties are poor, and a lubricity additive may be needed for pumps/injectors. During the fuel changeover, thermal shock and the drop in viscosity can cause pump seizure.
Enclosed Space Entry Permit, girişin tüm: The Enclosed Space Entry Permit is a formal control tool that documents that all safety conditions for entry have been met and authorizes entry. A.1203(33) and the company SMS require this permit to be signed by an authorized person (usually the Chief Officer). The permit defines which space is to be entered, for how long, by whom and under what conditions.
Endüstriyel bulaşık makinesi hem hijyen: The industrial dishwasher is critical for both hygiene and efficiency; its strainers are cleaned in every working period, the spray arms are checked for blockage and the rinse water temperature (typically a final rinse of ≥82°C for sanitizing) is verified. Limescale build-up (especially with hard water) reduces performance; descaler is applied periodically.
Eğitimde \"son dakika manevrası\" tuzağı: Training also covers the "last-minute maneuver" trap: if the give-way ship does not take action, under Rule 17 the stand-on ship first gains the right to maneuver on her own (17(a)(ii)), and then the obligation to do so (17(b)). Judging the timing of this transition correctly comes only through experience and repeated scenarios.
FO ısıtma, viskozite ve pompalanabilirli: FO heating is necessary for viscosity and pumpability; however, overheating (close to the flash point) is dangerous. The service tank is always supplied with clean, separated fuel.
Filika launching appliance ve on-load re: Lifeboat launching appliances and on-load release gear are subject to an annual thorough examination and operational test; every 5 years, a dynamic load test (testing the winch brake with 1.1x load, overload test of the release gear) is carried out by an authorized service provider. Davit falls are turned end-for-end at intervals of not more than 30 months and renewed when necessary due to deterioration or at intervals of not more than 5 years, whichever is earlier.
Filika motoru haftalık olarak toplam en: The lifeboat engine is run weekly for a total of at least 3 minutes (SOLAS III/20.6); water-cooled engines are not run without cooling from the sea or an auxiliary water supply for longer than the period specified by the manufacturer. During running, oil pressure, charging, exhaust color and ease of starting are observed; the battery charge condition is verified.
Fire main hattı, ana ve emergency fire p: The fire main is pressurized by the main and emergency fire pumps; at least two jets of water, not from the same hydrant, must be able to reach any normally accessible part of the ship. The Safety Officer periodically checks the tightness of the hydrant valve glands, the condition of the hoses (couplings, lining, cracks), the function of the nozzles (dual-purpose jet/spray) and the accessibility of the hose boxes.
Flanş montajında cıvatalar çapraz (star: When flanges are fitted, the bolts are tightened crosswise (star pattern) in stages of torque; on lines that run hot, the bolts are re-torqued after the line has been in service. The use of asbestos gaskets is prohibited (SOLAS II-1/3-5); when old gaskets containing asbestos are removed, respiratory protection and special disposal are required.
Flanşlı kaplin: Şaft segmentlerini birbi: Flanged coupling: connects the shaft sections to each other.
